This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 465-1734-1916
Cards: Wormfang Drake + Fiend Hunter + Changeling Titan
Color identity: GWU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 13 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).
